summary: D014 improved D013 by focusing on the stamped benchmark mark, but the NO/no pressure became clever and overdetermined; the ending still converted the object into a neat thesis rather than letting the material contradiction carry the poem.
strengths: The stamped mark NO 7 1975 was a tighter source object than D013's general disk/loading-dock image.
The body avoided datum-table display and preserved the no-live-value boundary without infrastructure diction.
The blue brick guard house / loading dock setting kept a useful concrete place pressure.
failures: The title and 'small round no' pun made the source mark feel like a solved symbol rather than a stubborn object.
'The dock took / the rest' explained the poem's logic too neatly, repeating D013's tendency toward conceptual closure.
The strongest untested pressure is not the stamped name itself but the contradiction that the mark for water is fixed above ground and out of water.
required_next_pressure: Test an above-ground reanchor: keep the disk/loading dock/guard-house facts, but remove the stamped-name pun and make the source contradiction be that the water mark is not in the water.
non_claim: Cold review is internal temporal-firewall judgment only; it does not admit D014, create reader evidence, or claim poem quality.
